properties.name: Kettle Valley Rail Trail (KVR)
properties.activities: Horseback Riding, Viewing, Mountain Biking, Hiking
properties.closure: Public Notice: Due to the Bald Range Fire near Summerland, the KVR is closed from ~2km east of Osprey Lake Recreation Site (at the junction with the Princeton-Summerland Road) to Summerland. Please do not use this section while Wildfire Services is actively working to combat the fire in the area. The maintenance of the trail is supported by the Regional District of the Okanagan Similkameen and the Trails to the Boundary Society. Both have active facebook pages with updated trail information.
